reclassified.judgement: Not a superscript and not a formula. It is the second, third and fourth letter of the word 'When', set in the paragraph's own body font at the paragraph's own body size, split off only because the letter before it is the 39.36pt drop cap 'W'. The rule fired on the size step down that a drop cap creates by definition.

Not a superscript and not a formula. The masthead sets the logotype 'Courier' at 55.31pt and the line 'T H E UNESCO ...' at 6.65pt beside it. Every character of that line is one font at one size; the rule split off the first letter alone because it is the one that follows the logotype. 'H E UNESCO' was already text, so the split was internally inconsistent as well as wrong.
